2. While AI systems can display simulated empathy through data-driven patterns, this does not equate to genuine human empathy. It is crucial to prioritize the creation of AI systems that assist humans in exercising their own capacity for empathy.

 Helpful advice for living and working in a world where AI is becoming more prominent.
